t: This Magnusson aluminium 6-step swingback A-frame stepladder provides a stable and secure platform for elevated tasks. Perfect for professional tradespeople tackling various jobs on site, from electrical installations to general maintenance, its integral tool tray saves repeated climbs. A large non-slip platform and high handrail offer enhanced stability and safety, supporting a maximum static vertical load of 150kg. The robust aluminium construction ensures durability for demanding worksite conditions.
b: Large Non-Slip, Steel Platform for Added Strength
High Safety Handrail for Added Stability
